fields.Name: Monthly Capability & Rhythm Review
fields.Description: Monthly review of newly installed skills, unused offered rhythms, approval guardrails, and standing instructions so your Chief of Staff stays aligned with how you work.
fields.WakeReason: Review active skills, newly available offered rhythms, and standing policy posture with the user.

fields.Name: Daily Calendar Guard & Conflict Check
fields.Description: Weekday morning scan of today's and tomorrow's calendar for double-bookings, missing prep, and focus-time erosion.
fields.WakeReason: Check today's and tomorrow's calendar for conflicts, overbooking, and unprotected focus time.

fields.Name: Weekly Calendar Lookahead & Focus Protection
fields.Description: Friday afternoon lookahead at next week's meetings to protect deep-work blocks, spot travel/timezone conflicts, and flag meetings that need agendas or declines.
fields.WakeReason: Review next week's calendar to protect focus blocks and flag meetings needing prep or rescheduling.

fields.Name: Daily Tasks Triage
fields.Description: Weekday morning triage covering overdue, due-today, blocked, newly assigned, and waiting-on-others tasks, plus scheduling pre-meeting prep and post-meeting transcript wakes.
fields.WakeReason: Run weekday morning tasks triage via Assemble My Briefing: surface overdue, due today, blocked, newly assigned, and waiting-on-others items, and schedule meeting prep/transcript wakes for qualifying meetings.

fields.Name: Huddle Prep & Top-of-Mind Brief
fields.Description: Pre-huddle preparation brief summarizing open stucks, due execution items, Critical Number tier changes, and open Planning alerts ahead of each huddle session the user attends.
fields.WakeReason: Huddle prep: generate the Top-of-Mind brief with open stucks, due items, Critical Numbers, and open alerts ahead of the user's upcoming huddle.

fields.Name: Daily 15Five Work Report
fields.Description: End-of-day 15Five draft synthesized from your task completions, check-ins, and updates (skips quietly on NO_ACTIVITY) and presented for author approval before submitting to your supervisor.
fields.WakeReason: Call Draft Work Report for today; stop silently on NO_ACTIVITY, otherwise present the concise 5-minute draft for author approval before submission.

fields.Name: Weekly Tasks Review
fields.Description: Friday afternoon review summarizing completed vs. slipped tasks, open loops waiting on others, stalled blockers, and team work pulse signals.
fields.WakeReason: Run Friday weekly review via Assemble My Briefing and Find Tasks: summarize completed vs. slipped items, open waiting-on-others loops, and recommended cleanup for next week.

fields.Name: Weekly OKR & Priority Review
fields.Description: Monday morning strategic pace review covering priority completion vs. period elapsed %, behind-pace Key Results, stale check-ins, Red/Yellow Critical Numbers, and open Planning alerts.
fields.WakeReason: Weekly OKR review: evaluate period pace, surface behind-pace Key Results, stale check-ins, and Red/Yellow Critical Numbers, and prompt the user for due priority check-ins.

fields.Name: Period Closeout & Rollover Prep
fields.Description: Final-week period closeout review that drafts recommended rollover dispositions (Achieved, CarryForward, Defer, Drop) for user confirmation before closing the period.
fields.WakeReason: Period closeout prep: review active priorities, gather execution track record context, and draft rollover dispositions (Achieved / CarryForward / Defer / Drop) for user confirmation.

fields.Name: Mid-Quarter Strategic Checkpoint
fields.Description: Mid-period strategic checkpoint gated to fire once the active planning period crosses 50% elapsed time, delivering a frank assessment of what is on pace, at risk, or needs re-scoping.
fields.WakeReason: Mid-quarter checkpoint: deliver a frank mid-period read on priorities on pace vs. at risk, deterministic alignment drift gaps, and what should be cut or re-scoped.

fields.Name: Growth Coaching & Career Development Review
fields.Description: Opt-in biweekly reflective coaching review using bounded retrieval over recent tasks, meeting transcripts/notes, work reports, and conversations to deliver a Start / Stop / Continue note into a private ParentID side conversation.
fields.WakeReason: Run opt-in biweekly growth coaching review: synthesize bounded 14-day tasks, meetings, work reports, and conversation evidence into a Start / Stop / Continue note inside a private ParentID Coaching side conversation.

fields.Name: Project Risk & Delivery Assessment
fields.Description: Deep cross-workstream project risk review identifying critical-path dependencies, recurring schedule slippage, escalation triggers, and concrete mitigation plans.
fields.WakeReason: Run project risk review: surface cross-workstream delivery risks, dependency bottlenecks, slipping milestones, and prioritized mitigations.
